## Plugin Submission / Update

- **Plugin ID:** `...`
- **Repository:** `https://github.com/...`
- **Type:** `theme` / `extension` / `content-source`
- **Changes:** Brief summary of what was added or updated.

### Checklist
- [ ] `plugin.json` matches `plugin-schema.json` (`apiVersion: 1`)
- [ ] Added/updated as a git submodule inside `plugins/<id>`
- [ ] Tested locally in Noctrinth via **Settings → Plugins → Install from .zip**
